ONLINE: A player says matchmaking is unreliable and the population is tiny, so the game feels worth it only with friends.
A player says the game needs constant online connection with no offline mode, so it isn't recommendable yet.
CONTENT: A player says the game is fun for Payday fans despite imperfections, but waiting for updates may be wise.
A player says the game is severely underdeveloped and they can't recommend it for now, though they hope it improves.
DESIGN: A player says the core mechanics were gutted and rebuilt poorly, and they could have done a better job.
A player says the quest system punishes playing stealthily, removing any incentive to sneak through missions.
STAB: A player says it would be a great game if it weren't riddled with bugs and didn't work properly.
A player sarcastically says the developers made the game essentially unplayable.
MONET: A player says the game looks cooler but feels greedy, with few weapons compared to the predecessor and paid heists.
